visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black beanie, white-rimmed glasses, and a black sweater leans over a large cardboard box in a brightly lit room with white walls and a black leather sofa. He pulls a gray plastic mailing bag from the box onto a white table covered with a green and yellow checkered cloth. (2) He holds up two black T-shirts on white hangers. He points specifically to a yellow 'PHOENIX CUP' patch on the sleeve of one and a white logo on the chest of another while speaking excitedly. (3) He displays a gray mailing bag with the brand 'verse.' clearly printed on it and tears it open with both hands. (4) He pulls a black hoodie from the bag and shows the front graphic of colored mahjong tiles. He turns it to show a 'SUPER MAJONG LEAGUE' logo on the back and then a golden emblem on the sleeve, pointing at it with his finger. (5) He holds up another black hoodie featuring a vibrant, colorful abstract print that he describes as looking like a kaleidoscope or fans. (6) He pulls out a pair of bright red shorts, showing the back which features white text and a mahjong tile design with the character '發'. (7) Quick cuts show clips from a show: two men at a table with '17LIVE' logos behind them, where one man shows his red underwear waistband; followed by a group of men in a different indoor setting. (8) The main character returns in a close-up shot, talking directly to the camera and ending with a thumbs up.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Primary setting is a white-walled room with a black leather sofa and a table with a green-and-yellow checkered cover. Secondary clips include a live-streaming studio with '17LIVE' backdrops and an indoor room with red pillars.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-tempo electronic BGM with a strong kick drum kicks in immediately. A male voice speaks with high energy, accompanied by the crunchy, broadband sound of cardboard being handled. (2) Continuous fast-paced narration with rising intonations. The BGM remains steady with a synth-based melodic loop. Soft rustling of T-shirt fabric creates subtle friction noises in the mid-frequency range. (3) A distinct, sharp transient sound of plastic being torn open triggers a change in focal point. The voice exclaims 'Ta-da!' with a bright spectral peak. (4) Narration continues at a high words-per-minute rate. Background music provides a rhythmic bed while the handling of a heavy hoodie creates low-frequency thuds and rustling. (5) The speaker's tone shifts to a more descriptive, excited pitch as he shows the colorful graphics. Fabric movement sounds are prominent. (6) A hard audio cut transitions to a clip featuring multiple male voices in a slightly reverberant studio space. Faint laughter and background chatter are audible underneath the main dialogue. (7) The original speaker returns with a drier, close-mic quality. The BGM begins to roll off in frequency before a final 'Bye-bye' is uttered and the track ends with a sharp cut.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To unbox and promote new merchandise for the Super Mahjong League (SML), specifically highlighting a collaboration with the brand 'verse.' and encouraging viewers to purchase the items before the tournament ends.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of products, mention of collaboration with 'verse.', and call to action for purchasing.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-energy merchandise reveal utilizing fast editing and energetic vocal delivery to engage a niche hobbyist audience (Mahjong players).
